scope: Primary-source architecture notes; no reproduced intelligence gains or adopted upstream timing claims

sources.title: Decode-Time Grammars
sources.mechanism: Instantiate grammar holes from a live typed environment of names/APIs. Reference positions may then choose only available bindings, with explicit scope/fallback boundaries.
sources.boundary: Declared-name support safety is not functional correctness; the model can select a wrong legal name. Completion guarantees are conditional on reaching acceptance within budget. Environment extraction must itself be trustworthy.
sources.local_relation: Relevant to installed Julia bindings and GPU operand names. Our finite canonical-token prototype is only a small static-support building block, not this paper's dynamic whole-program executor or evaluation.

sources.title: XGrammar engine integration
sources.mechanism: Documented matcher builds token masks on CPU, transfers/applies them to logits and accepts the sampled token. CPU work may overlap the model forward pass.
sources.local_relation: This standard integration is not an entirely device-resident per-token state machine. Do not label importing a CPU grammar library as satisfying the no-host-feedback goal.

sources.title: bpdecode repository
sources.mechanism: Author describes an experimental CPU/CUDA implementation of regex/grammar support with device masking and state commit.
sources.limits: Learning project, not independently reproduced or adopted code. CUDA implementation does not automatically provide our Julia/Mantle/Vulkan path. No upstream speed claim is used as a local benchmark.
